Backup and restore

Data stays in this browser on this device; it is not automatically synced to your phone or another computer. Export backups regularly and keep them somewhere safe.

Currency and privacy

Currency is displayed as LKR. For privacy, avoid entering full bank or card numbers. Card balances are personal tracking estimates and do not connect to your bank.
